selection_rule: Distinct directly stated value or guidance range per metric/period, including explicit same-value repetition for distinct periods; ranges and tolerances stay together; if more than three targets, select first three in passage order.

corrections.issue: Source publisher was scored as the measured subject in C1
corrections.resolution: Use the index explicitly named in the same frozen passage as entity; metric is monthly percent change.

corrections.issue: C2 was marked entity-null although the passage names the measured index
corrections.resolution: Use the explicitly named index as entity; no outside agency name is supplied.

corrections.issue: V1 required entity even when no measured subject is identifiable
corrections.resolution: V2 schema permits null; unknown fields require null rather than a guess.

corrections.issue: V1 reference used guidance state as accounting basis
corrections.resolution: Preserve v2 correction: current/prior guidance belongs in metric, while basis is null absent accounting or adjustment evidence.

evaluation_boundary: Retrospective old-output scoring and new-output scoring must both use v3, and all v1 results stay unchanged. This is a joint schema/prompt/reference engineering revision, not a causal prompt-only effect.
